blurb: Sweeping mountain views and refined living in a serene Stallion Springs setting.
description: Welcome to 28751 Gleneagle Ct, an exceptional Stallion Springs residence offering sweeping mountain views and refined living in a serene setting. This thoughtfully designed home features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a versatile bonus room ideal for an office, gym, or guest retreat. The primary suite offers private deck access, a walk-in closet, and picturesque views. The great room is highlighted by dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light.
